about: An Outlook-on-the-web-like inbox: each message is a list option named by its visible text (initials, sender, subject, time, preview — cut at 80 characters). Whether a message is unread is in the option's aria-label only, which the snapshot doesn't use for a control that has visible text: the page gives no unread marker.
